feedback_items.text: In episode 1 pilot, line 14: when the sister asked 'You came back, elder brother?', the subtitles said 'bhai-raj', which felt super cold and robotic for siblings crying in reunion! Should have been 'da-bhai'.
The subtitles move too fast! Can you keep characters per second under 18?
Why isn't this show dubbed in Spanish??? 1 star.
Line about touching the urn had the word 'touch' in English, totally broke immersion.
Background music is too loud in scene 2.
